changes.action: existing current records get new versions with mapped values (PENDED->PENDING)
add column; existing current records get new versions with line_of_business = "COMMERCIAL" (declared backfill)
column and historical values retained; field no longer populated, validated or served

changes.description: nw_medical_claims_csv: mappings, formats or processing limits changed
changes.action: new batches use the new transform version; existing records keep the transform version that produced them

ddl: ALTER TABLE "t_northwind"."claim" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "line_of_business" text
rollback: Rollback is available until any batch is processed under the new version.
Records created by data operations (tagged _migration_id) are deleted and the versions they superseded become current again.
The previous contract version is re-activated; added columns are retained (nullable) and simply unused, so no data is dropped.
notes: Data operations never update rows in place: they write new record versions tagged with the migration id, so prior versions keep their original meaning and contract version.
view_ddl: -- all generated views in this tenant schema are dropped, then:

CREATE VIEW "t_northwind"."current_plan" AS SELECT r."_record_id", r."_key", r."_batch_id", r."_raw_record_id", r."_contract_version_id", r."_transform_version", r."_loaded_at", r."_is_late", r."_migration_id", b.trust_status AS "_trust_status", r."plan_code", r."plan_name", r."plan_type", r."deductible", r."oop_max", r."effective_date", r."termination_date", r."updated_at" FROM "t_northwind"."plan" r JOIN core.batches b ON b.id = r."_batch_id" WHERE r."_is_current"

CREATE VIEW "t_northwind"."rpt_plan" AS SELECT r."_record_id", r."_key", r."_batch_id", r."_raw_record_id", r."_contract_version_id", r."_transform_version", r."_loaded_at", r."_is_late", r."_migration_id", b.trust_status AS "_trust_status", r."plan_code", r."plan_name", r."plan_type", r."deductible", r."oop_max", r."effective_date", r."termination_date", r."updated_at" FROM "t_northwind"."plan" r JOIN core.batches b ON b.id = r."_batch_id" WHERE r."_is_current"

      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (x."_key") x.* FROM "t_northwind"."plan" x JOIN core.batches xb ON xb.id = x."_batch_id" WHERE NOT x."_is_late" AND xb.trust_status = 'trusted' ORDER BY x."_key", x."_record_id" DESC) r
      JOIN core.batches b ON b.id = r."_batch_id"
